scenes.headline: I DREW THIS FROG.
scenes.voiceText: I drew this frog in ten seconds. Could AI turn it into a playable game?

scenes.headline: THREE SIMPLE RULES.
scenes.voiceText: I gave it three rules: tap to jump, dodge the rocks, and collect stars.

scenes.headline: DOES THE JUMP WORK?
scenes.voiceText: Here is the test. One tap makes the frog jump. The rock passes underneath.

scenes.headline: A STAR ADDS TEN.
scenes.voiceText: Catch a star, and the score goes up by ten.

scenes.headline: MISS THE JUMP...
scenes.voiceText: Miss the jump, and the run ends. The restart button lets you try again.

scenes.headline: THE DOODLE WAS THE START.
scenes.voiceText: The drawing was the easy part. A playable game needed rules I could actually test.
